purpose: The owner decisions that authorise the B10-hosted Supabase verification path, and the runtime facts that only the first GitHub Actions run can establish (recorded 2026-09-21).
rules: Decisions are recorded as confirmed by the owner; nothing here may be added without an owner decision. Every entry in runtimeFacts stays "unverified" until an actual b10-hosted run against the target project establishes it. A passing local suite never changes a runtimeFact.

target.note: IPv4 session-mode shared pooler. The direct host db.<ref>.supabase.co publishes no A record, so GitHub-hosted runners (IPv4 only) can reach the project only through this pooler.

decisions.decision: Region eu-central-1 (Central EU, Frankfurt) approved for this NON-PRODUCTION project.
decisions.scope: This non-production project only. Not approval for any production project. Specification-level O-2 and the data-residency part of B1-D remain OPEN.

decisions.decision: Decision B: the Supabase CLI stays local-only. Hosted migrations use psql. scripts/toolchain/supabase-cli.mjs and scripts/toolchain/deny-proxy.mjs are not modified.
decisions.scope: Consequence: the hosted database has no supabase_migrations.schema_migrations ledger, so hosted continuity is proved by the mechanism documented in README under b10-hosted.

decisions.decision: Exactly one registered GitHub Actions secret, B10_HOSTED_DATABASE_URL, permitted only in .github/workflows/ci.yml and only in the b10-hosted job. environment: remains forbidden; secrets.* remains forbidden by default everywhere else.

Expiry option B: an expired registration is a scoped rejection that disables only the b10-hosted job. It never fails the repository-wide policy check, and the semantics of every other policy register are unchanged.
decisions.scope: Implemented in scripts/policy/ci-secrets.mjs and scripts/policy/workflow-policy.mjs; the b10-hosted job self-gates on the same register before any step can reach the secret.

decisions.decision: PostgreSQL client major 16 from the Ubuntu 24.04 archive. No PGDG repository and no other package source.
decisions.scope: Pinned in toolchain/ci-system.json and asserted by scripts/ci/checks.mjs psql-version. The job applies SQL and runs queries only; no pg_dump or pg_restore.

decisions.decision: pgtap may be enabled out-of-band on this non-production project only, and must never be added to the committed migrations. Hosted pgTAP reuses the already-approved digest-pinned image public.ecr.aws/supabase/pg_prove:3.36.
decisions.scope: The image digest in toolchain/supabase-images.json is unchanged and no new image approval is requested.

decisions.decision: b10-hosted is a new additive job in .github/workflows/ci.yml, workflow_dispatch-only initially. The existing seven jobs are untouched and supabase-local remains the B10-local evidence path.
decisions.scope: The job never prints credentials, connection strings, raw database output, dumps or secret-bearing URLs; artifacts stay sanitised.

runtimeFacts.fact: An authenticated connection to the session pooler succeeds.

runtimeFacts.fact: The pooler role holds CREATEROLE, which migration 0003 requires to create app_api, app_system and app_worker.
